operations.body: PR 140 on GitHub (dgoings/workbook): desktop-release.yml on macos-15/ubuntu-24.04/windows-2025 with pinned actions, cascade jobs in release.yml, validate/plan/publish scripts with tests, per-target CLI staging and afterPack placement, detectUpdateChannel false and no NSIS universal installer. Adversarial review rehearsed the publisher under dash with electron-builder real asset names and caught two first-run breakers (rc channel manifests; desktop-tag stamping), both fixed. Not run end to end; the v0.6.0-rc1 cut is the proof.
